crit_percent.description: At or above this usage the widget switches to the error color.
crit_percent.label: Critical threshold (%)

display.description: What the widget shows next to the icon.
display.label: Bar text

glyph.description: Tabler icon shown in the bar.
glyph.label: Glyph

glyph_color.description: "By threshold" colors the icon by how full the disk is; the other options pin a palette role.
glyph_color.label: Icon color

mount.description: Path to watch, e.g. / or /home. A device (/dev/nvme0n1p2) or any directory inside the filesystem works too. Leave empty to follow the busiest disk.
mount.label: Mount point

refresh_seconds.description: How often the statvfs snapshot is re-read (2-600 seconds).
refresh_seconds.label: Refresh interval (s)

show_glyph.description: Turn off to keep only the text.
show_glyph.label: Show icon

tooltip_max.description: Extra filesystems are collapsed into a single "+N more" row.
tooltip_max.label: Max disks in tooltip

tooltip_mounts.description: Adds one row per other filesystem to the hover tooltip.
tooltip_mounts.label: List all disks in the tooltip

warn_percent.description: At or above this usage the widget switches to the tertiary color.
warn_percent.label: Warning threshold (%)

title: Disk Usage
tt_hint: Left click: details · scroll: switch disk
